question: 1² + 2² + 3² ...... + 25² = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of squares of first n natural numbers = [n(n + 1)(2n + 1)] ÷ 6

Given n = 25

Sum = (25 × 26 × 51) ÷ 6

Sum = 25 × 13 × 17 = 5525

**∴ The correct answer is 5525.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 1² + 2² + 3² + ... + 25²

This is the sum of the squares of the first 25 natural numbers.

Formula: Σn² = [n(n + 1)(2n + 1)] ÷ 6

⇒ n = 25

⇒ Sum = [25 × (25 + 1) × (2 × 25 + 1)] ÷ 6

⇒ Sum = (25 × 26 × 51) ÷ 6

⇒ Sum = (25 × 13 × 51) ÷ 3

⇒ Sum = 25 × 13 × 17

⇒ Sum = 325 × 17

⇒ Sum = 5525

**∴ The correct answer is 5525.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of first n natural numbers

The sum of 1 + 2 + 3 + ... + n is given by the formula [n(n + 1)] ÷ 2.

Sum of cubes of first n natural numbers

The sum of 1³ + 2³ + 3³ + ... + n³ is given by [[n(n + 1)] ÷ 2]².

Sum of first n odd natural numbers

The sum of 1 + 3 + 5 + ... up to n terms is equal to n².
